caption: Charles Marville, [Cloud Study, Paris] (1855–56)
alt: A sepia photograph of a broken sky over Paris: heavy dark clouds across the top, a bright band of heaped cumulus low down, and below them the dark silhouette of the city with a single domed building against the light.
bibliography: Marville, Charles. [Cloud Study, Paris]. 1855–56, albumen silver print from glass negative, Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (2005.100.353).
title: [Cloud Study, Paris]
